name: simple-prayer-website
description: Marketing + legal site for Simple Prayer (simpleprayer.app). Self-contained — not part of the app's workspace.

scripts.dev: bun run generate && bun run press && astro dev
scripts.build: bun run generate && bun run press && bun scripts/verify-times.ts && bun scripts/verify-install.ts && astro build && node scripts/generate-headers.mjs
scripts.fonts: uv run --with fonttools --with brotli python3 scripts/build-fonts.py
scripts.verify: bun run generate && bun scripts/verify-times.ts && bun scripts/verify-install.ts
scripts.generate: bun scripts/generate-tokens.ts && bun scripts/generate-domain.ts && bun scripts/generate-cities.ts
